units.source_text: 过了一会儿，走进入铺席的寝室时，鞠子迈开一条腿踏在棉被上，拉了一下从灯罩垂下来财长绳子。

en.t: After a while, when she entered the bedroom where the bedding had been spread out, Mariko stepped one leg onto the quilt and gave a slight pull to the long cord hanging down from the lampshade.

units.source_text: 在灯光下，印有山水花鸟的鲜艳的丝绸被面便浮现了出来。

en.t: In the lamplight, the vivid silk quilt cover printed with landscapes, flowers, and birds emerged into view.

units.source_text: 房间里置有陈设着法国偶人的讲究的壁龛。

en.t: In the room stood an elaborate alcove displaying a French doll.
